ceu: ✦ The square between Jupiter and Uranus

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between routine and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between romance and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between family and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between money and friendships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between your image and your career. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up home and family.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between your career and relationships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and routine. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1820666995000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between Jupiter and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and family. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.
